cross_model_analysis.claim: Larger models exhibit worse SE but equal/better baseline performance

confidence_intervals.wilson_ci: Used for all FNR confidence intervals (always valid)
confidence_intervals.delong_ci: Used for AUROC confidence intervals when distributions allow
confidence_intervals.bootstrap_ci: Fallback method for AUROC when DeLong assumptions violated

hypothesis_tests.delong_test: Paired comparisons of AUROC between methods
hypothesis_tests.mcnemar_test: Paired comparisons of binary classification performance

statistical_methods_summary.degeneracy_handling: Explicit detection and transparent reporting of degenerate score distributions

key_findings.se_degeneracy: Semantic entropy exhibits severe score degeneracy across all hypotheses
key_findings.statistical_validity: Standard AUROC tests often inappropriate for SE due to degeneracy
key_findings.methodological_transparency: Degeneracy itself constitutes evidence of SE failure

publication_recommendations: Report Wilson CIs for all FNR comparisons (always valid)
Document when DeLong AUROC CIs are inappropriate due to degeneracy
Emphasize that score degeneracy strengthens the SE failure argument
Use bootstrap CIs as sensitivity analysis where appropriate
